description.overview_html:
Experience Luxury and Relaxation at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

Nestled in the vibrant city of Da Nang, Vietnam, KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang offers a fresh and modern retreat with its grand opening in 2024. This newly built hotel boasts 314 elegantly designed rooms that blend contemporary comfort with local charm, providing an ideal sanctuary for both leisure and business travelers. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation with inclusive spa access, making every stay a rejuvenating experience. Designed to cater to families and solo travelers alike, KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang welcomes children aged 3 to 4 to stay free of charge, ensuring a warm and family-friendly environment. Check-in begins at 3:00 PM, allowing guests ample time to settle in and unwind, while check-out is conveniently available until 12:00 PM. Whether you're seeking a peaceful getaway or a lively exploration of Da Nang, this resort promises a luxurious and memorable stay for all.

Unwind and Enjoy at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

Discover a haven of relaxation and entertainment at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang, where your leisure experience is elevated with a range of luxurious facilities. Unwind in the tranquil gardens that offer a serene escape amidst lush greenery, perfect for a peaceful stroll or a moment of reflection. As the day winds down, indulge in the resort’s spa, sauna, and steamroom, designed to rejuvenate your mind and body after a day of exploration or business.

Exceptional Sports Facilities at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

Discover a range of outstanding sports amenities designed to enhance your stay at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang. Guests can enjoy the refreshing indoor and outdoor pools, perfect for a relaxing swim or invigorating exercise regardless of the weather. For those who prefer outdoor activities, the resort’s private beach offers a serene setting for beach volleyball, sunbathing, or simply strolling along the pristine shoreline. Complementing these facilities is the free fitness center, equipped with modern workout equipment to help you stay active during your vacation. Whether you're looking to maintain your fitness routine or just want to enjoy some leisure time in a beautiful setting, KOI Resort’s sports facilities provide the perfect environment for relaxation and recreation in the scenic coastal city of Da Nang.

Convenience Facilities at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang offers a range of thoughtful convenience facilities designed to enhance your stay. Guests can enjoy the comfort of free Wi-Fi available throughout all rooms and public areas, ensuring seamless connectivity whether you're relaxing in your room or exploring the resort. For added peace of mind, safety deposit boxes are provided to securely store your valuables, while daily housekeeping maintains a fresh and welcoming environment. Should you need to store luggage before check-in or after check-out, the resort’s luggage storage service is readily available.

Convenient Transport Facilities at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

At KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang, guests enjoy a range of excellent transport facilities designed to enhance their stay. The resort offers reliable airport transfer services, ensuring a smooth and stress-free journey from the moment you arrive in Da Nang. For those eager to explore the local sights, the resort also provides organized tours, making it easy to discover the beauty of the region. Valet parking and self-parking options are available for guest convenience, with the added benefit of complimentary parking, allowing visitors to explore freely without worrying about parking fees.

Luxurious Room Facilities at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

Experience ultimate comfort and convenience in our well-appointed rooms at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang. Each room features modern amenities including air conditioning to keep you cool and a flat-screen television for your entertainment. Unwind in the separate living room or step out onto the private balcony or terrace to enjoy scenic views. For your convenience, the rooms are equipped with a mini bar, refrigerator, and complimentary bottled water, ensuring refreshments are always at hand. Thoughtful touches like plush linens, fresh towels, and blackout curtains guarantee a restful stay. Indulge in the luxurious amenities designed for your relaxation, such as soft bathrobes, high-quality toiletries, and a hair dryer for your convenience. To start your day or unwind after a spa session, enjoy complimentary instant coffee available in your room. The spacious layout and premium facilities create a perfect retreat where comfort meets elegance, making your stay at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang truly memorable.

Exquisite Dining Experiences at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

Indulge in a delightful culinary journey at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang, where our on-site restaurant offers a diverse menu crafted to satisfy every palate. Guests can enjoy a hearty breakfast buffet each morning, featuring a wide array of local and international dishes to start your day with energy and flavor. For those seeking privacy and convenience, our attentive room service brings delicious meals directly to your door, ensuring a comfortable and satisfying dining experience in the comfort of your own room. Catering to guests with specific dietary needs, our halal restaurant provides a welcoming environment for halal dining, offering authentic and flavorful dishes that meet your dietary requirements. Daily housekeeping services ensure your stay remains clean and comfortable, allowing you to relax and focus on enjoying your time at the resort. Whether dining in our restaurant or in the privacy of your room, KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang promises a memorable and satisfying culinary experience.

Luxurious Room Options at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

Discover a range of exquisite accommodations at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang, designed to cater to every traveler’s preference. Choose from spacious options like the Deluxe Double Partial Sea View, offering 45 square meters of comfort, or indulge in the grandeur of the Villa 3 Bedroom and Villa Ocean View, each spanning 260 square meters with multiple beds to accommodate families or groups. For ultimate privacy and luxury, the Grand Suite with Private Plunge Pool provides a generous 160 square meters of elegant living space, while the Duplex 3-Bedroom Penthouse with Bathtub offers 290 square meters of opulence and relaxation. Booking your stay through Agoda ensures you receive the best prices available, making your luxurious getaway more affordable and hassle-free. With a seamless booking process, you can secure your preferred room type effortlessly, allowing you to focus on enjoying the inclusive spa access and the unforgettable experience awaiting you at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang.

Discover the Tranquil Beauty of Hòa Hải in Da Nang

Nestled along the pristine coastline of central Vietnam, Hòa Hải is a serene and picturesque area that offers a perfect escape from the bustling city life of Da Nang. Known for its expansive white sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters, Hòa Hải provides a peaceful retreat where visitors can unwind and soak up the sun. The region's lush greenery and gentle waves create an idyllic setting for relaxation, water sports, and leisurely strolls along the shore, making it an ideal destination for families, couples, and solo travelers alike.

Seamless Journey from Da Nang Airport to KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

Getting from Da Nang International Airport to KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang is a smooth and convenient journey. Located approximately 20 kilometers from the airport, the resort is easily accessible by private transfer, taxi, or ride-hailing services. Upon arrival at the airport, guests can opt for a pre-arranged private car or simply hail a taxi from the designated rank outside the terminal. The ride typically takes around 30 to 40 minutes, depending on traffic, offering a comfortable and hassle-free start to your stay. For those seeking a more personalized experience, many local transportation providers offer airport transfer services that can be booked in advance. Alternatively, ride-hailing apps like Grab are widely used in Da Nang and provide a convenient, transparent way to reach the resort. As you leave the city center, enjoy scenic views of the coastal landscape and lush greenery that surround Da Nang. Once you arrive at KOI Resort & Residence, you'll be greeted by its tranquil setting in Hòa Hải, ready to indulge in the inclusive spa access and relaxing amenities that promise a rejuvenating escape.

Discover the Natural and Cultural Wonders Near KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang

Located just a short distance from KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang, guests can explore the breathtaking Marble Mountains, a cluster of five marble and limestone hills renowned for their stunning caves, pagodas, and panoramic views. A visit to Non Nuoc Beach offers a serene escape with its pristine sands and crystal-clear waters, perfect for relaxing or enjoying water sports. For those interested in local culture and craftsmanship, Tu Hung Stone Arts presents exquisite stone sculptures and artworks, showcasing the region's rich artistic heritage. Additionally, the nearby Hoa Nghiem Cave provides a fascinating adventure into natural underground formations, while the vibrant local market offers an authentic taste of Da Nang’s lively atmosphere and delicious street food. Golf enthusiasts will find themselves close to Vina Capital Golf Course, Montgomerie Links, and Da Nang Golf Club, ideal for a day of leisure on lush, scenic fairways.

Exquisite Dining Options Around KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang

Guests staying at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang can indulge in a diverse array of culinary experiences just steps from the hotel. For a refined dining experience, Si Dining Restaurant offers contemporary Vietnamese cuisine in a stylish setting. Seafood lovers can savor the freshest catches at Ca Chuon Co Seafood Restaurant, renowned for its local flavors. Italian cuisine enthusiasts will enjoy the authentic dishes at Osteria Al Mare, while Baguette provides delightful French-inspired baked goods and light bites. Coffee aficionados can unwind at Brown Bean Coffee, perfect for a relaxing break. For a taste of international flavors, Don Cipriani's offers Italian classics, and Danabeach is ideal for a casual seaside meal. Nightlife and drinks are elevated at Jazz & Bar and Laluna Bar & Restaurant, both perfect spots to enjoy a vibrant atmosphere with delicious cocktails. Hoas Place and Baguette add to the variety, ensuring every palate is satisfied within easy reach of KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang.

Nearby Shopping Landmarks for Unique Souvenirs and Art

Guests staying at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang will find a treasure trove of shopping opportunities just moments away. Explore the exquisite collections at M. Legrand and Namaka Jewelry, perfect for those seeking luxurious accessories and unique jewelry pieces. For art and craftsmanship enthusiasts, Thuy Hoa Stone Handicraft, TY NGOC Handicrafts Sculpture Shop, and Xuat Anh Art and Stone Sculpture offer stunning handcrafted sculptures and decorative items. Additionally, the renowned Marble Sculptures, Non Nuoc Stone Carving, and Tien Hieu Marble Handicraft Sculptures provide an impressive selection of locally crafted stone and marble artworks, making it easy to find memorable souvenirs or exquisite gifts during your stay.

Affordable Luxury: Comparing KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang to City Averages

The KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang offers an exceptional stay with prices ranging from $101 to $150 per night, positioning it as a more premium option within the city’s hospitality scene. This resort provides guests with a blend of luxury and comfort, complemented by inclusive spa access that enhances the overall experience. While the price point is higher than many standard options, it reflects the resort’s superior amenities, spacious accommodations, and exclusive wellness facilities. In comparison, the average hotel room in Da Nang typically costs between $51 and $75 per night, making KOI Resort & Residence a more upscale choice for travelers seeking a touch of indulgence. For those willing to invest a little more, the resort promises a memorable stay with added value through its spa access and luxurious surroundings. Whether you're on a romantic getaway or a rejuvenating retreat, KOI Resort & Residence offers a compelling combination of quality and comfort that justifies its higher price tag in the vibrant city of Da Nang.

Exceptional Comfort and Value at KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang - Inclusive Spa access

Guests consistently praise KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang for its outstanding combination of comfort, cleanliness, and excellent service. With an impressive overall rating of 8.5, visitors find this resort to be a perfect retreat that offers both relaxation and convenience. The well-maintained facilities and pristine cleanliness contribute to a welcoming atmosphere that makes every stay memorable. One of the standout features of the resort is its inclusive spa access, which enhances the overall guest experience. Coupled with a prime location and attentive staff, visitors feel valued and well-cared-for throughout their stay. The resort’s commitment to providing great value ensures guests enjoy top-tier amenities and services without compromising on affordability, making KOI Resort & Residence Da Nang a highly recommended destination for travelers seeking comfort, quality, and relaxation.

other_policies:
Extra beds and baby cots are subject to availability and cannot be guaranteed.
- 	Children 0–4 years old stay free of charge when using existing bedding.
- 	Children 5–11 years old will be charged VND 500,000 net per child per night when using existing bedding.
- 	Children 12 years and above must use an extra bed and will be charged VND 1,000,000 net per person per night, including breakfast.
When booking more than 5 rooms, different policies and additional supplements may apply.
